units.source_text: 藤侍从把这信拿到正殿里来，和母亲同看。

en.t: Fuji Chamberlain brought this letter into the main hall and looked at it together with his mother.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍说道：“他的笔迹真漂亮啊！

en.t: Lady Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, said, "His handwriting is truly beautiful!

units.source_text: 小小年纪就这样聪明，不知前生怎样修成的。

en.t: To be so clever at such a young age, one wonders what discipline he must have cultivated in a previous life.

units.source_text: 他幼年丧父，母亲出家为尼，不曾好好抚育他，然而还是长得比别人优越，真好福气！”

en.t: He lost his father when he was little, and his mother became a nun, so she could not raise him properly, yet he has still grown up superior to others. What good fortune!"

units.source_text: 她的意思是责备自己的儿子字写得太坏。

en.t: What she meant was to reproach her own son for writing so poorly.

units.source_text: 藤侍从的回信，笔迹的确非常幼稚，写道：“昨夜你像经过水驿一般喝了就走，大家都诧怪呢。

en.t: Fuji Chamberlain's reply was indeed written in a very childish hand, and it said, "Last night you drank and left as if merely passing through a waterside post station, and everyone found it strange.
